_meta.openai/widgetDescription: A Pipefire card: the campaign, mailboxes, lead finding, replies or the reply draft the answer is about, with buttons that open the Pipefire console.

description: Write a new campaign from a short brief: who to email, where, and what you offer them. Pipefire writes the email sequence (two subject-line versions), starts finding and verifying the businesses, and saves it as a DRAFT. Nothing sends until you launch it. Read it with get_campaign. Takes up to a minute.

audience.description: Who to email, as a type of business. Example: "dentists" or "commercial roofing companies".

buyer.description: Who opens the email inside that business. Example: "the practice owner".

name.description: Campaign name. Defaults to audience and place.

offer.description: What you want the email to argue, in your own words. Example: "we fix their Google reviews in 30 days".

place.description: City, region or state. Example: "Leeds" or "Ohio". Leave out for a whole-country online search.

name: create_campaign

campaignId.description: The campaign id, for the other campaign tools.

link.description: Link to the new campaign, where it is read and launched in the Pipefire console.

status.description: Always draft: nothing sends until the user launches it.

title: Create a campaign
